text:
ajay: Heads-up — we have an embargoed chunked cutover for kernel-quant v2.4 tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. Plan: 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100%, 30m hold between steps. Keeping release notes embargoed until post-final-sweep. Need pin TTL and rollback gates confirmed.

lina: +1 on embargo. Can we set a sticky pin TTL of 6h after rollback so we don't flip-flop?

sam: 6h sticky seems fine. Also want a thermal backstop: if P99 latency increases > 120ms for 3 consecutive 5m windows, auto-roll back.

tess: Added: if error-rate (5xx) jumps > 1.5x baseline for any 10m aggregate, trigger rollback. Also require at least one successful KV-cache smoke on each region before 20% step.

kevin: ops checklist: preflight hooks run at 01:30 UTC. I will run the prebake and confirm artifacts. If prebake fails, we abort and notify.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan scheduled by @ajay for 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z. Canary steps: [5,20,60,100]. Hold per-step: 1800s. Rollback policy: manual unless auto-triggers fire.

ajay: I'm changing rollback policy to allow auto-rollback on the two criteria sam/tess called out. Keep manual fallback for region pin operations.

release-bot: Note: release notes are marked EMBARGOED. Will not publish until @release-owner gives :white_check_mark:.

lina: One more: pin TTL for canary should be 2h per-step with sticky 6h after rollback as discussed. That avoids traffic thrashing.

ajay: Confirmed: per-step TTL 2h, sticky rollback TTL 6h. Updating runbook.

kevin: I'm pasting the quick commands I'll run during cutover. Copy for reference:
```bash
# prebake artifacts
./ci/prebake.sh --job kernel-quant:v2.4 --regions eu-west-1,us-west-2
# start deploy
/deploybot start --bundle kernel-quant:v2.4 --strategy chunked --steps 5,20,60,100 --hold 1800
# quick smoke
./scripts/smoke_kv.sh --region $REGION || exit 1
```

sam: I'll watch telemetry and hook the deadman switch. If P99 > 120ms for 15m total in rolling window, I'll flip rollback.

oncall: I'll be on pager from 01:45->05:00 UTC. Slack escalation list set. If anything noisy, ping @oncall directly and call the wake channel.

tess: Who's the release-owner for the embargo lift? We need the person to sign-off after 2h stable at 100%.

ajay: @lina will own embargo lift sign-off. Lina, please confirm post-100% hold of 2h and then release-bot publishes notes.

lina: Confirmed. I'll run a final regression eval run and thumbs-up to release-bot.

release-bot: Scheduled publication pending @lina sign-off. Will add changelog entry template to PR after lift.

deploy-bot: Preflight completed by @kevin at 01:37 UTC — prebake OK in eu-west-1, us-west-2. Artifacts sha: 9f3c2d7.

ajay: Great. Final call: anybody object to this plan?

kevin: No objections from infra.

sam: All good from telemetry.

tess: Ack.

lina: Going to be online for final sign. :thumbsup:

ajay: Okay — roll window stands. I will trigger at 02:00 UTC. Keep this thread for live updates and short notes only. If you need longer context, link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embargoed-chunked-cutover-v2.4

deploy-bot: Deploy started at 02:00:03 UTC — 5% canary in us-west-2.

kevin: 02:02 smoke OK in us-west-2. KV latency nominal.

sam: Telemetry: P50 22ms, P95 68ms, P99 105ms. No error spike.

ajay: Advancing to 20% at 02:32 UTC.

deploy-bot: Step reached: 20% -> scheduled hold 1800s.

kevin: 02:35 smoke OK in eu-west-1.

sam: Telemetry: small P99 bump to 115ms for 5m window, not hitting 3x or 120ms threshold. Watchful.

ajay: Holding. No rollback.

deploy-bot: Advancing to 60% at 03:10 UTC.

kevin: 03:12 regional smokes OK.

sam: Telemetry stable. Error-rate steady.

deploy-bot: Final push to 100% at 03:45 UTC.

lina: Running final regression eval now.

sam: Telemetry after 100%: P99 98ms, error-rate baseline.

lina: Regression eval green. Lifting embargo and publishing release notes.

release-bot: Release notes published at 04:05 UTC. Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/342

ajay: Thanks everyone. I'll close the window. Leaving pinned rollback TTL as discussed for 6h. If any follow-ups, open a new thread. :tada:
